provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Sequences two events and insists the first be finished before the second starts (手を洗ってから食べる), which is what fits it to instructions and conditions. With a duration or state after it, it also gives the "ever since" reading that 〜たあとで does not (日本に来てから五年になる). For a loose "later on" use 〜たあとで, and for a deliberate preliminary step 〜た上で.

examples.ruby: 薬[くすり]を飲[の]んでから、三十分[さんじゅっぷん]ほど横[よこ]になった。
examples.english: After taking the medicine, I lay down for about half an hour.

examples.ruby: 日本[にほん]に来[き]てから、もう五年[ごねん]になります。
examples.english: It's been five years now since I came to Japan.

examples.ruby: 宿題[しゅくだい]を片付[かたづ]けてから、ゲームをしてもいいよ。
examples.english: You can play your game once you've finished your homework.

patterns.usage_note: Locates the second event later in time and nothing more, so the gap can be long and the two halves need not be connected (映画を見た後で、アイスを食べに行った). 〜てから presses the two actions together and can mean "ever since", and 〜た上で adds that the first act is groundwork for the second. 〜た後に marks the point in time and leans written; 〜た後で is the everyday form.

examples.ruby: 映画[えいが]を見[み]た後[あと]で、妹[いもうと]とアイスを食[た]べに行[い]った。
examples.english: After the movie, my sister and I went out for ice cream.

examples.ruby: 授業[じゅぎょう]が終[お]わった後[あと]で、図書館[としょかん]で待[ま]っているね。
examples.english: I'll be waiting in the library once class is over.

examples.ruby: 荷物[にもつ]を運[はこ]んだ後[あと]で、鍵[かぎ]をなくしたことに気[き]づいた。
examples.english: It was only after hauling the boxes in that I realized I'd lost my key.

patterns.usage_note: Makes the first act a deliberate preliminary the second one depends on (契約書をよく読んだ上で署名する), which is why it fills contracts, procedures, and business correspondence. 〜たあとで only says "later than" and 〜てから only that the first action is complete. Both halves are usually volitional acts of the same person, so accidents and natural events take 〜たあとで; unrelated 〜た上に means "on top of that".

examples.ruby: 契約書[けいやくしょ]をよく読[よ]んだ上[うえ]で、署名[しょめい]をお願[ねが]いします。
examples.english: Please read the contract carefully and only then sign it.

examples.ruby: 家族[かぞく]と相談[そうだん]した上[うえ]で、返事[へんじ]をさせていただきます。
examples.english: I'll give you my answer after I've had a chance to talk it over with my family.

examples.ruby: 現地[げんち]を自分[じぶん]の目[め]で確[たし]かめた上[うえ]で、結論[けつろん]を出[だ]したい。
examples.english: I'd rather see the site with my own eyes first and draw my conclusions from there.
